baseline.user_result: Mosaic practically disappeared; residual artifacts remain

Actual typed-glyph latency, video motion cadence, bandwidth and visual-correctness samples
Overlapping input window move, resize, scroll and close; no old-pixel resurrection
Bounded, versioned desktop metadata on existing guest transport with old-agent fallback
Plasma/KWin window geometry, stacking, visibility, focus and change notifications
Caret bounds from supported accessibility APIs with explicit unavailable fallback
VM and LXC guest packages and real session integration
Live KWin metadata verification on dedicated guests
Use metadata plus pixel changes to distinguish video and exact UI within one application
Prioritize typed-glyph display without waiting for an unrelated video backlog
Preserve capture/layout generations, occlusion correctness and conservative fallback
Qualify cropped video with overlapping text and moving/resizing windows
Bound playout/backlog during bandwidth changes without repeated static-quality changes
Maintain video/UI shared budget and independently responsive input
VM and LXC mixed-content runs
NVENC, QSV and VA-API with supported H264/HEVC paths
Firefox/macOS acceptance and longer session checks
Comparable QSM and RDP scenarios and network conditions; report limitations honestly
Complete published source matches tested binary payloads
Release debs, signed checksums and APT updates
Installation, upgrade and rollback documentation
Roll out qualified packages on the requested existing nodes
Prepare and deliver authorized discussion updates; retain evidence of delivery

invariants: One forwarded TCP port 8006 remains sufficient
No production host or guest power/session restart without specific authorization
Develop guest integration on dedicated test guests
Guest metadata is untrusted, bounded and authenticated by the existing console/session transport
No app text or window titles needed for metadata
Do not mark the objective complete based on tests narrower than the requirements

verified: Live isolated KWin5 geometry, stacking, visibility and native Qt caret geometry
D-Bus locking observer with simulated private locker
